title: Review the study capability M1 design in docs/design/reviews
summary: Retry of the rejected job: write an independent-style review of docs/design/study-capability-m1.md. It goes in docs/design/reviews/ and answers the eight checks in the design's §9 review gate. Also mark the design's status as reviewed, and make sure cargo test, clippy and fmt pass this time.

defaults_applied.how: The study capability design must be reviewed before it is built; this job produces that review.
Every review finding cites a design section or a BRIEF.md line, and any numbers are measured or labeled as estimates.
The review is written for an outside reader, following the format of the existing v0 reviews.
One new review document plus a one-line status update; no code.
cargo test, clippy and fmt --check are run so the earlier test failure does not recur.
The target (docs/design/study-capability-m1.md) and the review format were recovered from the repository.

assumptions: 'Independently reviewed' means a written review by a reviewer who shares no context with the design's author, saved in docs/design/reviews/, as §9 of the design requires.

The earlier rejection ('check test failed') came from a repository test or policy check, not from the review's content; the retry should run cargo test and fix any docs-related policy failure (for example a link or listing the xtask policy tests read).
The retry does not build the capability or rewrite the design; findings are recorded and left for the user to answer.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new file docs/design/reviews/study-capability-m1-review-1.md exists and states a verdict (approve, approve with changes, or reject) on docs/design/study-capability-m1.md, in the style of athena-v0-review-1.md.
The review answers each of the eight checks listed in §9 of the design in order, with findings graded by severity and each citing a section of the design or a BRIEF.md line.
The review lists decisions for the user as one-line choices and states what it read and any experiments it ran. It makes no claims about firstmate.
The design's status line is updated to say that review 1 exists and links to it; no other content of the design changes.
No files other than the review, the design doc, and optionally CHANGELOG.md change. No Rust, config, or governance files change, and no personal data appears.
Run `cargo test` (including xtask policy tests): all pass, including the non-rust-files, architecture and enforcement-map checks that failed or could fail on a docs-only change.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Building any part of the study capability.
Rewriting the design to answer the review's findings.
Studying firstmate or making claims about it.
Changing Rust code, athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI or other governance files.
departures: The reference forecast is kept for cost and time. I lowered p_verification_passes slightly, to 0.5, because the earlier attempt was rejected on a failed check and I could not identify the cause.
